newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy petrol costs seen steady in 1997 - UP.
newsitem.headline: Italy petrol costs seen steady in 1997 - UP.

text.p: Italy should spend a similar amount on petrol imports in 1997 as it did in 1996, despite the recent climb in the value of the dollar, trade group Unione Petrolifera (UP) said in a statement on Monday.
UP said current dollar strength against the lira had been compensated by lower crude prices on the international markets.

"If the dollar does not rise above its already very strong level against the lira and if crude prices stay at present levels of an average $18 a barrel then petrol costs in the second half of the year should not show a rise against the first half," the UP statement said.
"In fact...petrol costs in 1997 should not change from those of 1996," it added. UP said Italy spent 19 trillion lire on crude imports last year.
